http_response_headers_transform.description: Preserve HTML, Markdown and Next.js navigation response variants for documentation
http_response_headers_transform.expression: (http.host eq "agentapprovalprotocol.io" and ((http.request.uri.path eq "/docs" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/docs/")) or (http.request.uri.path eq "/specification" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/specification/"))))

vary.value: Accept, Purpose, Sec-Purpose, RSC, Next-Router-State-Tree, Next-Router-Prefetch, Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch

http_request_cache_settings.description: Keep negotiated documentation out of Cloudflare cache
http_request_cache_settings.expression: (http.host eq "agentapprovalprotocol.io" and ((http.request.uri.path eq "/docs" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/docs/")) or (http.request.uri.path eq "/specification" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/specification/"))))
